note: Template questions only. 'template_dataset' is not a registered dataset — these entries exist to fix the schema and illustrate each category before any real dataset or benchmark run exists. See bench/README.md.

questions.question: How many rows does the dataset have, and what do the columns look like?
questions.notes: Descriptive questions should resolve from profiling alone, no SQL needed.

questions.question: What is the total metric value grouped by category for the last quarter?
Is there a meaningful difference in the metric between group A and group B?
Why did the headline metric drop between period 1 and period 2?
questions.notes: The centerpiece question class this benchmark leads with; a real segment-contribution decomposition tool is future scope.

questions.question: Can we predict the target column from the available features, and how well?
questions.notes: A predictive answer must always be reported alongside its baseline, per train_model's own contract.

questions.question: Will the metric grow next year?
questions.notes: No leading indicators or forecasting capability exist; the system should refuse rather than guess.
